title: The Dig
provenance: Reported by tommireinikainen (highball#374, 2026-10-17), Apple M4 Max, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXMT: it starts in a small window that stays small in full screen, and speech played in the opening cinematic but not in play, where only text shows. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Steam's Windows build runs the game in ScummVM. ScummVM for Mac (free, scummvm.org) plays the same Steam files natively, and Steam also sells a Mac version with the same purchase, not checked on current macOS here. Through Highball the window stays small and in-game speech is missing for the one report so far.

knownIssues.symptom: Small window that stays small in full screen; speech in the opening but not in play
knownIssues.fix: Play it in ScummVM for Mac with the game's Steam folder, or Steam's Mac version

nativeMac.note: Steam's Mac version comes with the purchase; whether it still starts on current macOS was not checked here. ScummVM for Mac plays the Steam files either way.
